sections.title: Section 1: Advice On Plumbers And Decorators
sections.html:
leak

(noun). vệt rò rỉ

There is a leak over here

ceiling

(noun). trần nhà

This is the ceiling

plumber

(noun). thợ sửa ống nước

He is a plumber

pipe

(noun). đường ống dẫn

This is a water pipe

stain

(verb). lún xuống, bị lún, làm yếu đi

The ceiling is stained

bother

(verb). bận tâm

She didn't bother to listen to her boss

advert

(noun). tờ quảng cáo

This is a Pepsi's advert

avoid

(verb). tránh né

He avoids the holes on the floor

bump up

(verb). thổi bùng lên

The price of Bitcoin has been bumped up

temporary

(adjective). tạm thời

The company needs temporary staff who will work for 6 months

obviously

(adverb). một cách rõ ràng

Obviously the school cannot work without teachers.

plaster

(verb). trát vữa, thạch cao

He is plastering the wall

recommend

(verb). đề xuất, khuyến nghị

I recommend the food to you

reasonable

(adjective). hợp lý, có thể chấp nhận

The cost of a meal at this restaurant is reasonable

reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

He was a very reliable man whom anyone can trust .

quality

(noun). chất lượng

Many cities of China have very bad air quality

basically

(adverb). một cách căn bản

They are basically the same but iPhone 11 has 3 cameras instead of 2

sense

(verb). linh cảm

When suddenly see the black cat, I sense bad lucks

courteous

(adjective). lịch sự, nhã nhặn

Such a courteous man

tendency

(noun). khuynh hướng

She has the tendency to be shy in front of a stranger

cheat

(verb). lừa gạt

He is cheating

variety

(noun). sự đa dạng

There is a wide variety of vegetables to choose.

premium

(noun). khoản phí đóng thêm

You have to pay the premium if you want to increase the size of the room

involve

(verb). liên quan đến, bao gồm

The research involves animals

ladder

(noun). cái thang

This is a ladder

prepare

(verb). chuẩn bị

He is preparing for the camping

sections.title: Section 2: Museum Work Placement
sections.html:
placement

(noun). chuyến thực tập

The course includes a placement in Year 3.

assign

(verb). phân việc

He assigns the tasks to his employees

supervise

(verb). giám sát

She supervised the children playing near the pool.

relevant

(adjective). có liên quan

His experience in Marketing is relevant to his new job

notice

(verb). chú ý

Please notice that when the light turns green, you can go

formal

(adjective). trịnh trọng

It is a formal dinner party so you should wear a tuxedo

institution

(noun). tổ chức lớn

UNESCO is a famous institution

smart attire

(noun). quần áo trang trọng

He wears smart attire

recognise

(verb). nhận ra

Face ID can recognise the phone's owner

dusty

(adjective). bám bụi

Such a dusty bike

enormous

(adjective). to lớn, khổng lồ

Their house is enormous

punctual

(adjective). đúng giờ

She is a punctual student. She's never late for school

receptionist

(noun). nhân viên lễ tân

They are the hotel receptionists

workshop

(noun). hội thảo

Tommorrow there will be an educational workshop

prospect

(noun). viễn cảnh

This will be the prospect of the world in 2050

brief

(verb). tóm tắt

The manager briefs the new staff about different departments of the company

pointer

(noun). lời khuyên

He is listening to the pointers of the teacher

entrance

(noun). lối vào

I'll meet you at the main entrance.

staircase

(noun). lồng cầu thang, cầu thang gác

This is a staircase

statue

(noun). bức tượng

This statue is very famous in America.

central courtyard area

(noun). khu vực sân trung tâm

This is the central courtyard area, which is my favorite place in the house

donation

(noun). tiền đóng góp, tiền quyên góp

I'd like to make a small donation for the poor

gallery

(noun). phòng tranh ảnh

For me, this is the most beautiful gallery in HCM city

unfortunately

(adverb). không may là

Unfortunately, the supervisor knows that he is cheating during the exam

packed lunch

(noun). đồ ăn trưa được để trong hộp mang theo

That packed lunch looks great

circular

(adjective). thuộc về hình tròn, có hinh dạng tròn

This is a circular clock

notice board

(noun). bảng thông báo

I will look at the noticeboard if I have any question

sections.title: Section 3: Tutor About An IT Project
sections.html:
improvement

(noun). sự cải thiện, quá trình cải thiện

I want to have some improvement in my IELTS band score.

database

(noun). cơ sở dữ liệu

This is the database of Google

straightforward

(adjective). dễ hiểu, không lòng vòng

His talk is quite straightforward

evaluate

(verb). định giá, đánh giá

They evaluate the performance of the competitors

catalogue

(noun). bản liệt kê mục

This is a catalogue

competitiveness

(noun). tính cạnh tranh

The competitiveness is the thing that I like about the race

it's a pity

(noun). đáng thất vọng

It's a pity that Brazil lost 1-7 to Germany

payroll

(noun). hệ thống tính lương, bảng lương

This is a payroll of a company

manual

(adjective). làm bằng tay, thủ công

He still works on an old manual typewriter

accounting

(noun). kế toán

She works in accounting department

electronically

(adverb). một cách điện tử

She is signing electronically

transfer

(verb). chuyển sang

This player will be transferred to the other team

automatically

(adverb). một cách tự động

This car can move automatically

inventory

(noun). nhà kho chứa hàng

Such a big inventory

inaccurate

(adjective). không chính xác

He made inaccurate attempts

internal

(adjective). nội bộ

These are internal relationships of a company

swipe card

(noun). thẻ quẹt

He is using a swipe card

assessment

(noun). sự đánh giá

The test is the assessment of the learning ability

customer service

(noun). bộ phận chăm sóc khách hàng

She is the leader of the customer service

systematic

(adjective). có hệ thống

The systematic links between the nails look great

premise

(noun). nhà cửa, cơ ngơi

This is my parents' premise

incur

(verb). chịu, gánh

The company will incur cost when the employees make phone calls

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

He is making an observation

elect

(verb). bầu ra

The President is elected by people

overload

(verb). quá tải

Try not to overload yourself with work

arrange

(verb). sắp xếp, lên kế hoạch

He is arranging his work so that he can have time to play sports

queue

(noun). hàng (người, xe…) xếp nối đuôi nhau chờ

There was a long queue at the shopping mall

sections.title: Section 4: The Tawny Owl
sections.html:
familiar

(adjective). quen với

Covid-19 makes me familiar with wearing masks

tawny owl

(noun). con hù nivicon

This is a tawny owl

common

(adjective). phổ biến

Phở is a common food in Vietnam

nocturnal

(adjective). thuộc về ban đêm

Most bats are nocturnal

venture

(verb). liều, mạo hiểm, cả gan

She rarely ventured outside at night

natural habitat

(noun). môi trường sống tự nhiên

Gorillas' natural habitat is usually tropical forests

carry out

(verb). tiến hành (thường là làm nghiên cứu, thí nghiệm)

They carried out an experiment

distribution

(noun). sự phân phối

Supermarkets are the main distribution channel of instant noodles

marshy

(adjective). thuộc vùng đầm lầy

This area is very marshy

obvious

(adjective). hiển nhiên, rõ ràng

It's obvious that he loves her

adaptation

(noun). sự thích nghi

Cars produced in England always require drivers to sit on the right-hand side. However, when being imported to Vietnam, there are some adaptations

maneuver

(verb). chuyển hướng

This car maneuvers well

plumage

(noun). bộ lông chim

Male peacocks have beautiful plumage

camouflage

(noun). cách ngụy trang

The snake's light brown skin acts as (a) camouflage in the desert sand

perch

(verb). đậu trên

A blackbird was perching on the gate

visual

(adjective). thuộc về thị giác

This is used to test my visual ability

capacity

(noun). khả năng làm gì đó

She has a great capacity for being a clown

contribute

(verb). đóng góp, góp phần

Plastic bottles contribute significantly to the seriousness of water polution

layout

(noun). bản thiết kế, sự bố trí

There is a correct layout for business letters.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

I have to combine my needs and my money when buying a laptop

potential

(adjective). tiềm năng

Students are the potential customer of the banks in the future when they want to borrow money for going to the university

prey

(noun). con mồi

A lion is chasing after his prey

mammal

(noun). động vật có vú, loài thú

Cows, humans and whales are all mammals.

urbanised landscape

(noun). phong cảnh đô thị

This is a photo of urbanised landscape

disperse

(verb). giải tán, đi khỏi

When the rain came down, the crowds started to disperse

reluctance

(noun). sự miễn cưỡng

He went to the party with reluctance
